finalText:
**Root cause: Redis outage cascaded into full API downtime.**

At `02:14:07` `[api]` lost its Redis connection (`ECONNREFUSED 10.0.0.12:6379`). Cache fell back to direct store reads, causing miss storms and store overload.

Reconnect attempts (7 through 12, every ~100s) all failed with the same `ECONNREFUSED`. Redis never came back.

Timeouts and queue depth climbed steadily for 17 minutes, `worker-1`/`worker-2`/`scheduler` all timing out every few seconds, queue depth passing its max of 500 around `02:29`.

At `02:31:44` `worker-2` hit `JavaScript heap out of memory`, restarted, then at `02:31:52` the supervisor declared the api unresponsive and killed the process group. **Service went down at that point.**

Next: check why Redis at `10.0.0.12:6379` was unreachable for 17+ minutes and add backpressure so timeouts don't snowball into OOM.
